LESSON: LENGTH

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Measurement
Topic 2.1: Length

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Length. Read, look at the pictures, practise, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: LOOK AND LEARN

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-1/mathematics/page-053.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 1 — page 53]]

From your pupil's book (page 53)

Activity Use hand spans to measure teacher’s table

Work to do Measure 1. The pupil’s desk is _____ hand spans.

2. The pupil’s text book is ______ hand spans.

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-1/mathematics/page-115.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 1 — page 115]]

From your pupil's book (page 115)

Activity 1 Activity 2 How long? How long?

The length of the The length of the book is _____ bottle window is ____ tops sticks

1. The learners desk is ______ bottle tops

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-1/mathematics/page-169.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 1 — page 169]]

From your pupil's book (page 169)

Activity Use strides to measure the shorter length of the classroom

The shorter length of the classroom is ____ strides.

Work to do What is the length? 1. Length of teacher’s table is ______ pencils

2. The length of the pupil’s desk is _____ textbooks 3. The length of the classroom window is ___ pencils.

SECTION 3: TRY THIS

1. Look again at the examples or pictures above.
2. Tell a parent or friend what Length means, using your own words.
3. Copy one example into your exercise book and change it to fit your school or home.
4. Underline three new words and find out what they mean.

SECTION 4: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Length.
2. Complete any “Work to do” items shown in the pupil book pages above.
3. Create three of your own practice questions on this topic.
4. Answer the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after finishing.

SECTION 5: REMEMBER

1. Topic: Length
2. Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
3. Learning materials: Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 1
4. Revise with the quiz now.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
